==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|exequte|exequute|exsecute|exsequute||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*sekʷ-|id=follow}}
From {{der|en|fro|executer}} (French {{m|fro|exécuter}}), from {{der|en|la|exsecutus}}, past participle of {{m|la|exsequor||to follow (up/through)|pos=particularly in the sense {{m-g|to go through with a deed or punishment}}}}, from {{m|la|ex-||out}} + {{m|la|sequor||to follow}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɛksɪˌkjuːt/|/ˈɛɡzɪˌkjuːt/}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-execute.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/eɡ.zɪ.kjuːʈ/|a=Indic}}
* {{hyphenation|en|ex|e|cute}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[kill]], especially as [[punishment]] for a [[capital]] [[crime]]. {{C|en|Capital punishment}}
#: {{cot|en|murder}}
#: {{ux|en|There are certain states where it is lawful to '''execute''' prisoners convicted of certain crimes.}}
#: {{ux|en|According to international treaties, it is illegal to '''execute''' prisoners of war.}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Henry 6-1|act=II|scene=iv|page=104|column=1|passage=Was not thy Father, ''Richard'', Earle of Cambridge, / For Treaſon '''executed''' in our late Kings dayes? }}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[carry out]]; to [[put into effect]].
#: {{ux|en|Your orders have been '''executed''', sir!}}
#: {{ux|en|I'll '''execute''' your orders as soon as this meeting is adjourned.}}
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=9|passage=Why delays / His hand to '''execute''' what his decree / Fixed on this day?|year=1873}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[perform]].
#: {{ux|en|to '''execute''' a difficult piece of music brilliantly}}
#: {{ux|en|to '''execute''' a turn in ballet}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|law}} To [[carry out]], to [[perform]] an act; to put into [[effect]] or cause to become [[legally]] [[binding]] or [[valid]] (as a [[contract]]) by so doing.
#: {{ux|en|to '''execute''' a contract}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|computing}} To start, [[launch]]{{,}} or [[run]].
#: {{syn|en|start|launch|run|open}}
#: {{ux|en|to '''execute''' a program}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|computing}} To [[run]], usually [[successfully]].
#: {{ux|en|The program '''executed''', but data problems were discovered.}}

====Synonyms====
* See also [[Thesaurus:kill]]
